hospitals.label: Hospitals / health complexes
hospitals.definition: Explicit hospital-type list, including private/NGO hospital-clinics, upazila health complexes and trauma centres. Not all registry institutions.

publicHospitals.label: Government-owned hospital listings
publicHospitals.definition: Hospital-type list AND explicit fully government, autonomous or semi-autonomous ownership. Missing ownership is never assumed government; not restricted to DGHS-run facilities.

privateClinics.label: Private hospital / clinic listings
privateClinics.definition: Exact DGHS facility type: Private Hospital / Clinic. Includes records whose separate ownership field is missing.

bloodBanks.label: Blood-bank listings
bloodBanks.definition: Exact DGHS facility type: Blood Bank. Counts registry entries, not available blood units, donor stock or all hospital transfusion services.

diagnostics.label: Diagnostic-centre listings
diagnostics.definition: Exact DGHS facility type: Consultancy & Diagnostic Center.

communityClinics.label: Community-clinic listings
communityClinics.definition: Exact DGHS facility type: Community Clinic.

all.label: All registry institutions
all.definition: Includes administrative offices, training institutes and other non-treatment institutions. Do not interpret this as a hospital count.
